scope: Isolated Canopy Breaker host only; parent TREE site not deployed

investigation.userEvidence: Screenshot confirms saving-backlog pause; user reported three additional occurrences.
investigation.databaseFinding: transactionDatabase default called getDatabase on every request. Pinned @netlify/database 2.0.1 constructs a fresh pg.Pool or NeonPool each call, causing connection setup/pool churn instead of warm reuse.
investigation.transportFinding: One in-flight save, maximum 120 inputs per batch, and 120 queued inputs made delayed requests beyond roughly 2 seconds open the pause menu and limited catch-up throughput.
investigation.productionPostRequestTimings: Netlify observability query returned no data; no exact authenticated save duration or distribution was inferred.
investigation.healthTimingLimit: These are read-only health requests from the executor, not the player’s authenticated frame POSTs; cold starts, network and container placement affect them.
investigation.remainingBoundedHold: A prolonged stall reaching the total unacknowledged limit or an actual network error still safely holds the run; resume countdown is retained.
investigation.healthTimingConclusion: Three samples before and after are both around3 seconds. These small read-only samples do not establish a meaningful player save latency improvement; pooling benefit is verified structurally and batching tolerance through deterministic regression.

preserved: Explicit pause reasons and frozen three-second resume countdown

validation.slowSaveSimulation: Three logical minutes of repeated 3-second frame saves, plus a 7-second spike, produce no saving pause; actual app loop and deterministic engine used.
validation.longStallSimulation: Total pending caps at 900 and freezes; checkpoint drains 60+600+240 with correct revisions before resume.
validation.serverBatchChecks: 600 delayed frames accepted with elapsed credit; 601 rejected without writes; repeated/concurrent 600 applied once; sustained 60 Hz and 900 credit cap verified against actual local database.
validation.testCommand: for test_file in tests/*.test.mjs; do node --wasm-num-compilation-tasks=1 --max-old-space-size=192 --no-wasm-tier-up "$test_file" || exit; done
